subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Anatomy of a Scam Website
description: A quick win: understand The Anatomy of a Scam Website.

hook.text: A fake online store looks identical to a real brand. Products are shown, reviews are glowing, prices are low.

buildup.text: Scam websites use stolen product images, fake trust badges, and cloned checkout pages.

discovery.text: They often appear through paid search ads, ranking above real stores in search results.

twist.text: After you pay, the product never arrives — or a cheap counterfeit shows up weeks later.

climax.text: These sites disappear within weeks and reappear under new domains. Takedowns can't keep up.

punchline.text: The store looked perfect. That was the whole trick.

quiz.question: How do scam websites often reach potential victims?
options: Through paid search ads above real stores
